    Bug 1905803 - Switch l10n_bumper to use thunderbird-l10n repo. r=dandarnell
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D217619

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/l10n-bump/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/l10n-bump/kind.yml
index 2d3141e21e5..823ee1d4f46 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/l10n-bump/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/l10n-bump/kind.yml
@@ -8,7 +8,6 @@ transforms:
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release_version_bump:transforms
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task:transforms
 
-
 task-defaults:
     worker-type: tree
     worker:
@@ -19,19 +18,24 @@ task-defaults:
         ignore-closed-tree: false
         push:
             by-project:
-                comm-(central|beta): true
+                comm-beta: true
+                comm-central: false
                 default: false
         source-repo:
             by-release-type:
                 beta: https://hg.mozilla.org/releases/comm-beta
+                nightly: https://hg.mozilla.org/comm-central
                 default: https://hg.mozilla.org/comm-central
         l10n-bump-info:
             by-release-type:
+                # Whenever the `beta` config changes, make sure to make
+                #     the corresponding change in merge-automation/kind.yml
                 beta:
                     - name: Thunderbird l10n changesets
                       path: mail/locales/l10n-changesets.json
                       version-path: mail/config/version.txt
-                      l10n-repo-url: "https://hg.mozilla.org/projects/comm-l10n/json-pushes?version=2&tipsonly=1"
+                      l10n-repo-url: "https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-l10n"
+                      l10n-repo-target-branch: main
                       ignore-config:
                           ja:
                               - macosx64
@@ -53,8 +57,9 @@ task-defaults:
                 default:
                     - name: Thunderbird l10n changesets
                       path: mail/locales/l10n-changesets.json
+                      l10n-repo-url: "https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-l10n"
+                      l10n-repo-target-branch: main
                       version-path: mail/config/version.txt
-                      l10n-repo-url: "https://hg.mozilla.org/projects/comm-l10n/json-pushes?version=2&tipsonly=1"
                       ignore-config:
                           ja:
                               - macosx64
@@ -77,7 +82,7 @@ task-defaults:
 tasks:
     l10n-bumper:
         name: l10n_bumper
-        description: l10n changesets bumper (action/cron)
+        description: l10n changesets bumper
         run-on-projects: []
         treeherder:
             kind: build
